industrial_cities.name: Jubail Industrial City
industrial_cities.authority: Royal Commission for Jubail and Yanbu
industrial_cities.description: A major industrial center on Saudi Arabia's eastern coast, known for petrochemicals and refining.
industrial_cities.overview: Jubail Industrial City is located on the Arabian Gulf coast in the Eastern Province. Its proximity to energy resources, raw materials, and shipping routes has supported the development of petrochemical, refining, and associated manufacturing industries. The city also includes infrastructure, residential areas, and public services.

industrial_cities.name: Yanbu Industrial City
industrial_cities.authority: Royal Commission for Jubail and Yanbu
industrial_cities.description: An industrial center on Saudi Arabia's Red Sea coast, with refining and petrochemical activities.
industrial_cities.overview: Yanbu Industrial City is located on the western coast of Saudi Arabia. It supports petroleum refining, petrochemicals, and related industries. Its coastal location, port infrastructure, and connections to energy resources make it an important industrial center on the Red Sea.

industrial_cities.name: Ras Al Khair City for Mining Industries
industrial_cities.location: North of Jubail, Arabian Gulf coast
industrial_cities.authority: Royal Commission for Jubail and Yanbu
industrial_cities.description: An industrial city specializing in mineral processing, metals, and mining-related manufacturing.
industrial_cities.overview: Ras Al Khair City for Mining Industries is located north of Jubail on the Arabian Gulf coast. It supports mineral processing and manufacturing activities, including phosphate and aluminium production. Its infrastructure is designed to support industrial development connected to Saudi Arabia's mineral resources.

industrial_cities.name: Jazan City for Primary and Downstream Industries
industrial_cities.location: North of Jazan City, Red Sea coast
industrial_cities.authority: Royal Commission for Jubail and Yanbu
industrial_cities.description: A developing industrial hub supporting primary industries, downstream manufacturing, and investment in southern Saudi Arabia.
industrial_cities.overview: Jazan City for Primary and Downstream Industries is located on the Red Sea coast in southern Saudi Arabia. It is designed to support primary and downstream industries through integrated industrial infrastructure, access to port facilities, and opportunities for manufacturing investment.

industrial_cities.name: KAEC Industrial Valley
industrial_cities.location: King Abdullah Economic City, near Rabigh
industrial_cities.description: A manufacturing and logistics zone within King Abdullah Economic City, connected to King Abdullah Port.
industrial_cities.overview: KAEC Industrial Valley is part of King Abdullah Economic City on Saudi Arabia's Red Sea coast. It supports manufacturing, logistics, and industrial investment, with sectors including automotive, pharmaceuticals, packaging, and building materials. The industrial ecosystem also includes the King Salman Automotive Cluster.

industrial_cities.name: Riyadh Second Industrial City
industrial_cities.authority: Saudi Authority for Industrial Cities and Technology Zones (MODON)
industrial_cities.description: An established industrial city supporting manufacturing and industrial business activities in the Riyadh region.
industrial_cities.overview: Riyadh Second Industrial City is one of the industrial cities developed under MODON. Established in 1976, it is located south of Riyadh along Al-Kharj Road. It provides industrial land and infrastructure for manufacturing and related business activities.
key_features: Location in the Riyadh industrial network
